notes.title: Rogue Knight 1.1.0 new upgrade shop
notes.content:
New content: Cultist

Cultist will provide repeating upgrades. As you raise your Damnation level you will get much more materials, Cultist will be there to help you spend them. Surely they will not go to any nefarious purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762072/600162b5d2af1755c42f906905b0cb1d5eb98760.png[/img]

Cultist is available in town after reaching stage 5 (Palace). For existing stages he will already be there if you killed Cursed King on that save. His upgrades are not required for Perfectionist achievment.

New content:
[list]
[*] 3 new epic spells
[*] 3 new legendary spell
[*] 2 new legendary items
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Wind charges now regenerate much faster out of combat
[*] Sentinel (stage 4 boss) nerfed
[*] Stages 2 and 3 are slightly easier
[*] Legendary items that gave 100% resistance now give 80%
[*] True Sword Essence 10 -> 12 base damage
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Knight 1.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]New leatherworker upgrade: Spacious Compartments doubles stack size of materials (from 12 to 24)
[*]On Damnations levels 1 and higher dark crystals (highest tier upgrade material) starts dropping from stage 3 (normally stage 4)
[/list][u][/u]

notes.title: Rogue Knight is out now!
notes.content:
The day is here, Rogue Knight is OUT NOW!

I'm incredibly excited to see you all play my game.

Also for the next 2 weeks there will be a 10% launch discount.

notes.title: Game is coming out at November 20, end of Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762072/689a40dae472266cf28259422467d71ed0c22c82.gif[/img]

In less than 3 days Rogue Knight will be released. I have worked hard to get to this point and I hope you will enjoy playing it.

Tomorrow I will close down access to Demo, if you wanted to try it out this is your last chance. That being said demo version does not have a lot of improvements I made as I worked on finishing full version.

If you have any comments or questions you can find me on [url=https://discord.com/invite/kYYHcX3]Discord[/url].
